lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Library\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
6 uses of the private API of the server in 4 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.
The frontend or a template builds 9 URLs below /apps/library/ that no route of the app matches. The request fails at run time.
